categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Matches 'Scripts and tools' label and modifies signing scripts under contrib/.
categories.rationale: Prevents exposing the codesigning private key passphrase in process listings by feeding it to osslsigncode via standard input rather than command-line arguments. While detached signing tooling touches sensitive signing keys, codesigning is typically performed in isolated environments, making this worthwhile credential hardening rather than a critical vulnerability.
